component.name: jellyfin
component.description: TAPPaaS module jellyfin: triage of its own critical/high CVEs (#788). Jellyfin 10.11.11 runs on its NixOS VM (port 8096), published through the firewall's Caddy to home, netbird and internet zones; the library is an NFS share mounted at /media. Live check: the server launches nixpkgs jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3 (--ffmpeg flag), not the ffmpeg 8.1.2 the scan reports; 8.1.2 is in the closure only via opencv (frei0r) and chromaprint, and the only 8.1.2 library ffmpeg loads is libavutil.so.60 through chromaprint. Library files are attacker-relevant input to jellyfin-ffmpeg, so decoder/demuxer CVEs in the 7.1 range are kept affected against that fork. Hardware acceleration is none and the VM has only a QEMU VGA (no render node, no NVIDIA). GStreamer, libtiff, libxslt and cups come in via gtk4/zenity (SDL), opencv and pipewire chains that neither the jellyfin process nor ffmpeg maps; gst-plugins-good/-ugly are absent. Filter names floodfill/swaprect/hqdn3d/quirc/frei0r and the spdif format do not occur in Jellyfin's encoding assemblies.

analysis.detail: GitHub Actions workflow in the jellyfin-ios repository; not part of the Jellyfin server package.
Ubuntu's CUPS AppArmor profile; NixOS ships no such profile and only cups-lib is present (via gtk), no cupsd.

VobSub .idx/.sub heap overflow; Jellyfin picks up external .idx/.sub next to videos and hands them to its ffmpeg (jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3, inside the 2.1+ range). Risk here: medium: needs a crafted file in the library (NFS share writers, media fetched from untrusted sources); Jellyfin is internet-reachable but the parse runs in a transient ffmpeg as the hardened jellyfin user.. Action: Jellyfin runs nixpkgs jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3 (not this ffmpeg 8.1.2, whose libavcodec/libavformat nothing on the VM loads), which the scan does not list; a fix needs a jellyfin-ffmpeg release carrying the upstream patch, so check the nixpkgs jellyfin-ffmpeg bump, not only ffmpeg 8.1.3.

Vulkan HEVC hardware decoder, 8.0+ only; Jellyfin's ffmpeg is the 7.1-based jellyfin-ffmpeg, hardware acceleration is off and the VM has no GPU (only QEMU VGA), and the 8.1.2 libavcodec is never loaded.
NVDEC double free needs an NVIDIA GPU with NVDEC hwaccel; the VM has no NVIDIA device and Jellyfin's HardwareAccelerationType is none.
S/PDIF muxer; Jellyfin never selects the spdif output format (absent from its encoding code), and the 8.1.2 libavformat is never loaded.

RTP/ASF depacketizer loop; reachable only through a network stream URL (library .strm or a Live TV source), not local media files. Risk here: low: infinite-loop DoS of one ffmpeg process; needs a .strm in the library pointing at an attacker RTSP/RTP source, no Live TV tuner is configured.. Action: Jellyfin runs nixpkgs jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3 (not this ffmpeg 8.1.2, whose libavcodec/libavformat nothing on the VM loads), which the scan does not list; a fix needs a jellyfin-ffmpeg release carrying the upstream patch, so check the nixpkgs jellyfin-ffmpeg bump, not only ffmpeg 8.1.3.

Risk here: medium: needs a crafted file in the library (NFS share writers, media fetched from untrusted sources); Jellyfin is internet-reachable but the parse runs in a transient ffmpeg as the hardened jellyfin user.. Action: Jellyfin runs nixpkgs jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3 (not this ffmpeg 8.1.2, whose libavcodec/libavformat nothing on the VM loads), which the scan does not list; a fix needs a jellyfin-ffmpeg release carrying the upstream patch, so check the nixpkgs jellyfin-ffmpeg bump, not only ffmpeg 8.1.3.

MACE6 decoder heap corruption via crafted CAF; a .caf in the music library is probed and decoded by jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3. Risk here: medium: needs a crafted file in the library (NFS share writers, media fetched from untrusted sources); Jellyfin is internet-reachable but the parse runs in a transient ffmpeg as the hardened jellyfin user.. PNG/APNG encoder heap write from a crafted eXIf chunk; Jellyfin extracts embedded cover art with ffmpeg and may write it as PNG. Risk here: low: the eXIf-writing PNG encoder path looks like 8.x code the 7.1-based jellyfin-ffmpeg may lack (unverified); reachable only when Jellyfin re-encodes an embedded PNG cover.. Action: Jellyfin runs nixpkgs jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3 (not this ffmpeg 8.1.2, whose libavcodec/libavformat nothing on the VM loads), which the scan does not list; a fix needs a jellyfin-ffmpeg release carrying the upstream patch, so check the nixpkgs jellyfin-ffmpeg bump, not only ffmpeg 8.1.3. Confirm whether 7.1.4-3 contains the eXIf writer; if not, this can become not_affected/code_not_present.
vf_quirc (QR) filter; Jellyfin never builds a filtergraph containing it (absent from its encoding code) and users cannot inject filters.

Use-after-free on channel data after close; libssh is loaded by jellyfin-ffmpeg as its SFTP client and is reachable only via an sftp:// stream URL. Risk here: low: needs a library .strm with an sftp:// URL to an attacker SSH server; outcome is a crash or UAF in one ffmpeg process.. Action: Fixed in a newer libssh; next nixpkgs pin that carries it.
Server-side GSSAPI key-exchange check; libssh is used only as libavformat's SFTP client, and the VM's sshd is OpenSSH.
TIFFReadRGBATile crash; libtiff is only linked by openjpeg/libwebp command-line tools, gdk-pixbuf/gtk4 and opencv, none of which Jellyfin or its ffmpeg load (ffmpeg decodes TIFF natively).
putcontig8bitYCbCr44tile overflow; libtiff is only linked by openjpeg/libwebp tools, gdk-pixbuf/gtk4 and opencv, none of which Jellyfin or its ffmpeg load.
libxslt is only in the closure via gst-plugins-bad -> lrdf -> raptor2 (gtk4/zenity chain); nothing running on the VM loads it.
